title: 2059. Minimum Operations to Convert Number

examples.explanation: We can go from 2 → 14 → 12 with the following 2 operations. - 2 + 12 = 14 - 14 - 2 = 12
We can go from 0 → 3 → -4 with the following 2 operations. - 0 + 3 = 3 - 3 - 7 = -4 Note that the last operation sets x out of the range 0 <= x <= 1000, which is valid.
There is no way to convert 0 into 1.
